create_peft_regex_for_lora: create a regex pattern to apply LoRA to selected vision or language layers of a model
get_lora_linear_modules: discover all Linear LoRA layer classes from the PEFT tuners library dynamically
enable_gradient_checkpointing_hooks: register forward hooks on model modules to enable gradient checkpointing for VLMs and non-standard models
review_skip_quantization_modules: review the list of module names that should be skipped during quantization like lm_head and vision_tower
refactor_peft_regex_target_modules: refactor the PEFT regex generation to target custom module lists for LoRA fine-tuning
